test.query: SELECT row_number() OVER () FROM numbers(40000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT count() OVER (ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) FROM numbers(40000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(number) OVER (ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) FROM numbers(30000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT lag(number) OVER () FROM numbers(20000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT lag(number) OVER (), lag(number, 2) OVER (), lead(number) OVER (), lead(number, 2) OVER () FROM numbers(10000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT lag(number, 1000) OVER (), lead(number, 1000) OVER () FROM numbers(15000000) FORMAT Null

SELECT lagInFrame(number) OVER (ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING), leadInFrame(number) OVER (ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM numbers(20000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT nth_value(number, 3) OVER (ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) FROM numbers(20000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT percent_rank() OVER () FROM numbers(25000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT cume_dist() OVER () FROM numbers(20000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY number) FROM numbers(20000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY number % 1000) FROM numbers(15000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY number % 1000) FROM numbers(15000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT number, toString(number) AS s, [number, number] AS a, lag(number) OVER () FROM numbers(20000000) FORMAT Null
